response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing real-time credit/liquidity systems — key requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven ability to build and ship event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture contributions via testing, CI/CD, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No demonstrated leadership of engineering teams larger than 10 people
Lacks explicit experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulatory compliance systems
No evidence of architecting model-agnostic, auditable AI systems with feedback loops in production
